model_boundary: game LIF checks; measured topology for MaleCNS, synthetic for toy; not biological validation

decoder.feature_schema: eight means + six windows per output + right-left/approach-avoid windows; steering centered on individual neutral activity; additional anatomical outputs each contribute mean plus six windows

protocol.selection: changes selected using development fit/validation only; final models refit on all training individuals; test and controls evaluated frozen

normalization.method: equal KC magnitude per MBON; common APL gain = min(1, mean KC Hz / mean APL Hz)
normalization.reason: sampled KC drive and nearly saturated APL feedback silence avoidance MBONs
normalization.kc_budget_reason: 40 is closest to neutral untrained PI in the seed-19 sweep of 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 120; independent evaluation uses seed 71
